newsitem.title: ITALY: Hugo Boss, Grey Europe win pan-Europe ad award.
newsitem.headline: Hugo Boss, Grey Europe win pan-Europe ad award.

text.p: Hugo Boss, the clothes manufacturer, and its advertising agency, Grey Europe, were awarded the European Association of Advertising Agencies' first pan-European award on Thursday for the launch of new products or services.

The EAAA said at its annual conference in Rome that another "gold" award went to Delta Air Lines and its agency, Abbott Mead Vickers for a second category -- "major change of strategy for existing products and services."
Nokia/SEK telecommunications group and Grey Advertising won the third and last award category of "long-term advertising achievement."
The EAAA also announced "silver" and "bronz" award winners as part of its first Pan-European advertising "effectiveness awards"
The EAAA conference in Rome grouped delegates from advertising agencies and trade bodies in 24 countries.
